set.tovw: Lead grade B: two sources and a placed farm (treasure thread)

tw-horrigan-boscobel-1930.st: Local paper: the brothers distrusted banks and buried their money on the farm; robbers tried at least three times (c.1923 holdup took anywhere from a few hundred to $40,000 by differing reports; the 1930 attempt ended in murder); diggers worked the ground in all directions around the house. No find reported 1931-45. Private: permission.
